MEASUREMENT_RUNS_EMPTY.csv.row_unit: One actual physical measurement attempt; every attempt/rerun retained.

fields.study_id: An author-approved prospective study identity, not the template creation date.
fields.independent_unit_id: Link to the approved source/unit manifest; aliquots and technical repeats are not automatically independentN.
fields.batch_id: Actual preparation batch, not a generated row identifier.
fields.aliquot_id: Actual sample aliquot; record reused sample/changed shear history in the state manifest.
fields.run_id: Actual instrument run identity; unique within study.
fields.paired_block_id: Use only if the comparison design genuinely supports pairing. Blank does not create pairing.
fields.comparison_arm: full_scan_workflow, sparse_anchor_workflow or validation_truth_only; author approves the actual design before results.
fields.execution_order: Actual execution order within the relevant block; identifies drift/history risk, not proof of randomization.
fields.measurement_protocol_id: Reference to approved real protocol, native rate schedule and instrument settings.
fields.material_state_record_id: Reference to formulation/state/temperature/preparationage/preshear/scandirection metadata, not a guessed default.
fields.actual_started_utc: Timezone-aware UTC from actual workflow logs; leave absent if not observed.
fields.actual_ended_utc: Timezone-aware UTC from actual workflow logs; no imputation from point count.
fields.run_status: completed, failed, interrupted or not_executed. Failed/interruptedattempts retain resources.
fields.acquired_point_count: Observed data point count, a descriptor rather than an experimental-saving estimator.
fields.rerun_of_run_id: Earlier run which led to this rerun; blank if not a rerun.
fields.resource_record_complete: true/false for required resource records; missing is not zero.
fields.raw_trace_sha256: Hash of the actual instrument trace held under its appropriate access role; avoid publishing private raw paths.
fields.notes: Unexpected events and deviations; do not use free-text to silently exclude difficult units.

RESOURCE_EVENTS_EMPTY.csv.row_unit: One observed resource phase of one actual run. Phases may overlap; durations must not be summed blindly.

fields.run_id: Link to one actual attempt in run ledger.
fields.phase: preparation, loading, equilibration, measurement, data_transfer, model_inference, cleaning, retest or other; describe protocols separately.
fields.started_utc: Actual timezone-aware phase start, no invented timestamp.
fields.ended_utc: Actual timezone-aware phase end, no invented timestamp.
fields.instrument_occupied: true only if this phase makes the instrument unavailable to another sample.
fields.operator_active: true only for active operator work under the approved accounting definition.
fields.material_amount: Actual observed use or waste; missing remains absent, not zero.
fields.material_unit: Actual compatible unit such as mL or mg; do not sum incompatible units.
fields.direct_cost_amount: Observed direct expense under approved accounting; no fabricated currency conversion.
fields.currency: Actual currency; conversion, if any, must be defined and reported.
fields.evidence_record_id: Identifier/hash reference to instrument/operator/resource source log, not a private filesystem path.

accounting_rules: Keep validation-study total resources separate from intended deployment-workflow resources. Truth-only full scans remain visible in study total even if not counted as deploymentmeasurementsteps.
A sparse workflow must actually be executed. Selecting six values from a completed full scan is offline masking and provides no executed reduction in acquisition workload.
Report wall clock, occupied instrument time, active operator time, material use and direct cost separately; choose a primaryresourceendpoint before outcomes.
For overlap, use interval unions for a given occupiedresource category, not a sum that double-counts simultaneous phases.
Retain failed, interrupted and repeated attempts, including preparation and cleaning, and report the comparison failure denominator.
Compare workflows at a prespecified acceptable quality/materialerror level. Faster but unusable outputs do not establish useful experimental efficiency.
State sample reuse, aliquot pairing and scanorder explicitly because shear history/materialage can change the response.
Aggregate by the approved real independent unit, not points, phases, masks, generatedcurves or instrument timing samples.
No ratio of39and6points, nominal360secondscan, code runtime or synthetic example substitutes for actual experimental resource records.
Blank fields are missing evidence, not assumed zero expense or proof that a protocol succeeded.
